text: Okay... hm, let me see here. I get that you need the details to input them, sure. But I really don't want to type out my full new address. Like I mentioned, I'm hoping the system can find it when I ask about the specific order. It's the same address for both changes, after all. Is there no way to just update it based on the order request without me giving the full address now?
zh: 好的……嗯，让我看看。我明白您需要详细信息以便输入，当然。但我真的不想把我的完整新地址打出来。就像我之前提到的，我希望系统在询问具体订单时能自动找到它。毕竟，这两个更改都是同一个地址。难道就没有办法根据订单请求直接更新，而不需要我现在提供完整地址吗？
